name: bringup-e1-dataplane
about: Bring-up matrix row dataplane (E1): the vendor's data-plane setup after the control-plane loop - re-check the ready id2 payload (device-RAM MSDU-info ring-pointer table), the clean exception state, ONE read-only MAC slot-5 reachability probe (CA 0x40040000 via the region-3 translation), then the vendor's own TXQ-table address sync (g0 id1 key 0x0320) through the contracted h2d_txq_addr_sync token. MAC ring REGISTER programming (B2b) is a driver deliverable and is deliberately NOT done by devmem here.

steps.name: note
steps.about: E1 needs the wave-3 dp-bringup driver token h2d_txq_addr_sync (contracted name; the JSON is the single edit point if the lane names it differently). Without the token the plan is refused as module-attr-missing and the matrix row is BLOCKED.

steps.name: dp-seed
steps.about: the ready handshake seeded the data plane: g4 id2 payload 0x01060850 = device-RAM MSDU-info ring-pointer table (ACP-mapped into MAC +0x10)

steps.name: pre-pack
steps.about: clean control state before the data-plane messages: mask 0, staging 0, out[0] (CA 0x40039010) 0

steps.name: ctx-create-t1
steps.about: the data-plane messages still need the ordered control state (the 2026-11-25 validated create+sync precondition)

steps.name: txq-sync72
steps.about: the vendor's TXQ config sync 0xd8, ordered after the context create

steps.name: clean-state
steps.about: both control messages ran clean: no exception mask, no staged frame

steps.name: mac-probe
steps.about: B2a single READ-ONLY reachability probe of the MAC host-interface block (device CA 0x40040000 -> region-3 BAR0 0x3F8000; the datapath ladder's B2a). Capture-only: a bus-error/empty read stops the session here and no host write is attempted. NOTE the BENCH-LADDER text says BAR0 0x402A000; the region-3 rule gives 0x3F8000 - this probe resolves the discrepancy with actual (attended) reads.

steps.name: dp-txq-sync
steps.about: the vendor's own data-plane init message: HCC g0 id1, u16 key 0x0320, 4-byte device VA of a host-allocated zeroed 0x2524 B non-cached TXQ table (builder dp_build_txq_addr_sync). ONE frame, one idea.

steps.name: post-dp
steps.about: the data-plane message did not fault the firmware: exception mask and staging stay clean

steps.name: note-end
steps.about: E1 row PASS = MAC slot-5 window readable + key-0x0320 message consumed with mask 0. The RX/TX ring register program (B2b) and the 8-byte MSDU-info ring posts are the dp-bringup driver's deliverable, not automation devmem writes.
